dish.title: Vietnamese Ca Kho: Caramel-Braised Catfish with Black Pepper and Jasmine Rice
dish.description: Catfish pieces braised in a dark sugar caramel with fish sauce, coconut water, shallots, garlic, black pepper, and Thai chiles until glazed and sticky, scattered with scallions and served with jasmine rice and cucumber slices.

recipe_version.title: Vietnamese Ca Kho: Caramel-Braised Catfish with Black Pepper and Jasmine Rice
recipe_version.description: Catfish pieces braised in a dark sugar caramel with fish sauce, coconut water, shallots, garlic, black pepper, and Thai chiles until glazed and sticky, scattered with scallions and served with jasmine rice and cucumber slices.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.display_name: fish sauce whose label lists anchovy and salt (sugar allowed), no shrimp

ingredients.name: coconut water
ingredients.display_name: coconut water whose label lists coconut water only

ingredients.name: catfish fillets
ingredients.preparation: cut into about 14 pieces, 2 by 2 1/2 inches

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the catfish into 2-inch pieces and pat dry. Slice the shallots and chiles, mince the garlic, cut the scallions, slice the cucumber, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Caramel-braise the fish
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): heat the sugar and 2 tbsp water in the 12-inch heavy skillet over medium, swirling, until deep amber, about 5 minutes. Add the shallots and garlic for 30 seconds, then slowly add the fish sauce and 1 cup coconut water and stir until the caramel dissolves, about 2 minutes. Lay in the catfish in one layer with the pepper and chiles and simmer, basting and turning once, until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze and the fish reaches 145 F, about 18 minutes. Add the scallions for the last minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and serve the catfish and its glaze beside it with the cucumber slices.

Compared with korean-braised-mackerel-radish: a sugar caramel and black pepper glaze with no radish or gochugaru.
